scopeLimits: Mac host only. No Duo throughput, physical iPad sharing or A10X performance acceptance.
Key benchmark has stable high-confidence EDM excerpts. Exact full-track and modulation accuracy remain unverified.
Rhythm F1 measures events within 25 ms, not the percentage of fully correct tracks. Review results assume acceptance of every offered candidate.
Rhythm confidence is a development-bin estimate. It overestimates the stronger group on independent validation. No automatic full-grid replacement.
Neural Engine compute plans do not prove runtime device utilisation.
Replay timings reuse first-pass results and beat checkpoints. Other host activity was present. Fresh timing comparisons are observational.
Original Traktor references remain unverified, except for Erik’s one-beat correction to the bar choice for 99 Problems.

keyConfidence.domain: Published stable-key GiantSteps+ excerpts. Whole-track and cross-genre reliability remain unverified.
keyConfidence.rule: Fixed development bins with Laplace smoothing. Acceptance threshold uses raw score >= 0.8.

keyWindowRepair.scope: Repair missing and damaged key windows using a derived diagnostic input. This does not simulate device suspension.

keyWindowComparison.scope: Whole-track upstream Torch inference versus bounded 120-second windows on the same native features. This measures window-boundary effects, not musical accuracy.
